controls.label: PIONIER image, November 2016
controls.notes: The SQUEEZE reconstruction its authors published for November 2016 (Montargès et al. 2018, CDS J/A+A/614/A12), 32 pixels of 0.5 milliarcseconds, cast onto a sphere of the limb-darkened diameter. Shown as published, finer than the 1.8 milliarcsecond beam of the longest baseline: the features are the authors' reconstruction, with a convective contrast they measure at 5 to 6 percent. The star has no measured rotation axis: the axis shown is celestial north, a display convention. The far hemisphere is unobserved and carries the no-data grid.

controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour from a measured spectrum of the star (Crimean photoelectric). The disc is unresolved, and no darkening toward the edge is measured.
controls.notes: The colour of CE Tauri's Crimean photoelectric spectrum. The scan is from 24 October 1982; a second scan in February 1983 is paler, and CE Tau varies. No resolved image of the surface is cast here.
